verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a release process. `yy skills update` selects the "latest compatible stable release" (gh-6), the repo calls itself the "independently versioned" canonical source (docs-20, docs-19), and a validation script checks plugin version parity (gh-7). These suggest ongoing versioned maintenance but do not show how recent any release is. missing for 10: dated recent releases or changelog, evidence of issue triage, evidence of accepted community contributions or PRs, independent corroboration of maintenance activity.
